questions.q: Which sentence correctly forms a polite request for a document?
options: Could you send the invoice?
Could you to send the invoice?
Could you sending the invoice?
Could you sent the invoice?
questions.explanation: Après could you, on utilise la base verbale send. La politesse de la formule ne change pas cette construction grammaticale.

questions.q: You need the signed contract, rather than any information about the project. Which request is the clearest?
options: Could you send any document that seems useful?
Could you send the signed contract for project Atlas?
Could you send something about project Atlas?
Could you let us know about the project when possible?
questions.explanation: La demande identifie le livrable et le projet. Les autres formulations obligent le destinataire à deviner quel document est réellement attendu.

questions.q: An email says: “We would appreciate if you send it.” Which revision is grammatically appropriate?
options: We would appreciate if could you send the report.
We would appreciate you could sending the report.
We would appreciate it if you could send the report.
We would appreciate it if you could to send the report.
questions.explanation: La construction attendue est appreciate it if, suivie d’une proposition. Could send constitue une formulation polie et grammaticalement correcte.

questions.q: A colleague can either send a report or confirm that it is unavailable. Which request makes both expected responses clear?
options: Please confirm whether the report is available.
Please send the report if it is available, without replying otherwise.
Please confirm the date on which the report was prepared.
Please send the report or let me know if it is unavailable.
questions.explanation: La demande retenue prévoit l’envoi du rapport ou une réponse négative explicite. Confirmer sa disponibilité, sa date ou ne répondre qu’en cas de disponibilité ne spécifie pas ces deux réponses attendues.

questions.q: A message reads: “Could you deal with this?” No earlier email or attachment identifies the task. What is the main weakness?
options: The action and object of the request are unspecified.
The request incorrectly uses the base form after could.
The request necessarily commits the recipient to a deadline.
The request states that the task has already been completed.
questions.explanation: La phrase est grammaticalement possible mais inutilisable sans contexte : this n’identifie aucune tâche. Il faut préciser l’action et le dossier concernés.

questions.q: You want to ask whether a colleague is available for a call, without claiming that the call is already arranged. Which wording fits?
options: The call has already been scheduled for tomorrow.
Would you be available for a call tomorrow?
Thank you for confirming tomorrow’s call.
As agreed, the call will take place tomorrow.
questions.explanation: La question sollicite une disponibilité. Les autres phrases présentent à tort la réunion comme confirmée ou déjà convenue.

questions.q: In an email, what does “I have attached the signed agreement” mean?
options: The recipient is being asked to sign an unidentified document.
The agreement has been accepted by every party to the contract.
The signed agreement is intended to accompany the email as a file.
The signed agreement will be discussed during a future meeting.
questions.explanation: Attached indique la présence annoncée d’un fichier joint. La formule ne démontre ni la validité du contrat ni l’accord de toutes les parties.

questions.q: You are sending two files: a draft budget and an approved timetable. Which sentence identifies their status accurately?
options: I have attached the approved budget and the draft timetable.
I have attached the two approved documents.
I have attached the final versions of both documents.
I have attached the draft budget and the approved timetable.
questions.explanation: Le statut de chaque pièce doit être préservé. Inverser draft et approved ou déclarer les deux fichiers définitifs change l’information transmise.

questions.q: An email says “Please find attached the report”, but only a spreadsheet of raw data is attached. What should be corrected?
options: The stated attachment and the actual file should be reconciled.
Keep the wording because raw data necessarily constitute the completed report.
Rename the spreadsheet Final report without checking that it contains the report described.
Ask for acknowledgement of the report without correcting the mismatch between the message and the file.
questions.explanation: La formule ne remplace pas la vérification du fichier envoyé. Il faut joindre le rapport annoncé ou décrire correctement le tableur réellement transmis.

questions.q: A report is available only through a secure web link, with no file attached. Which sentence is accurate?
options: The full report is attached to this message; no web access is needed.
You can access the report using the secure link below.
The report has been downloaded to your computer as part of this email.
Please use the printed copy enclosed with this email.
questions.explanation: Un lien d’accès n’est pas une pièce jointe. La phrase doit décrire le mode de transmission réel pour éviter que le destinataire cherche un fichier absent.

questions.q: You have just corrected a draft and want the recipient to use the new attachment. Which sentence best identifies the replacement?
options: Please combine the old and new drafts without identifying which revisions replace earlier text.
Please treat the new draft as approved without further review.
Please use the attached revised draft instead of the earlier draft.
Please keep using the earlier draft even where its content conflicts with the replacement supplied.
questions.explanation: La phrase identifie explicitement la version à utiliser sans la présenter comme approuvée. Une révision et une validation sont deux statuts différents.

questions.q: What does “Please reply by Monday” normally express?
options: The reply must be sent only on Monday.
The reply should be withheld until Monday has ended.
The reply is expected every Monday indefinitely.
Monday is the latest permitted day for the reply.
questions.explanation: By introduit une échéance : la réponse peut arriver avant lundi. On Monday désignerait le jour précis de l’action, sans cette même marge.

questions.q: Which completion is grammatically appropriate in a business request: “Could you provide us with ___ about the delivery?”
options: the requested information
an information
the requested informations
an requested informations
questions.explanation: Information est normalement indénombrable dans ce sens : the requested information convient, sans article indéfini an ni pluriel informations.

questions.q: A translator changes “The review takes place on Friday” to “The review must be completed no later than Friday”. What has changed?
options: A scheduled event date has become the earliest date on which work may begin.
A scheduled event date has become a completion deadline.
A completion deadline has become a scheduled review appointment.
A one-day appointment has become a period during which reviews take place every day.
questions.explanation: On Friday situe l’événement. No later than Friday impose une date limite d’achèvement : cette obligation supplémentaire n’est pas contenue dans la phrase initiale.

questions.q: A team works across several countries and needs a precise submission deadline. Which addition removes a potential time ambiguity?
options: The weekday alone, without a calendar date.
The sender’s local clock time without identifying the time zone.
The calendar date, time and relevant time zone
The recipient’s usual office opening time, without a submission date.
questions.explanation: Une heure sans fuseau et une mention relative du jour peuvent être ambiguës. La date complète, l’heure et le fuseau rendent l’échéance opérationnelle.

questions.q: Which completion correctly follows the expression “look forward to” in a professional email?
options: I look forward to receive your reply.
I look forward to received your reply.
I look forward receive your reply.
I look forward to receiving your reply.
questions.explanation: Dans look forward to, to est une préposition suivie ici de la forme en -ing : receiving. Ce n’est pas le to d’un infinitif receive.

questions.q: An email asks for a reply “as soon as possible” although a review meeting starts at 10:00 on 8 April. What revision best supports planning?
options: State the required reply date and time explicitly.
Keep as soon as possible and mark the subject line urgent, without specifying the reply deadline.
Ask only for acknowledgement of the email, without stating when the substantive reply is needed.
Copy a supervisor while leaving the required reply time unstated.
questions.explanation: As soon as possible exprime une urgence mais ne fixe pas une limite commune. Une date et une heure explicites permettent d’organiser la réponse avant la réunion.

questions.q: Which English adjective normally means “actuel” when describing a position held now?
options: Previous
Current
Actual
Eventual
questions.explanation: Current désigne ici la situation présente. Actual signifie plutôt réel ou effectif ; previous renvoie à une situation antérieure.

questions.q: A budget report compares planned costs with the costs really incurred. Which expression identifies the latter?
options: Standard costs
Budgeted costs
Actual costs
Forecast costs
questions.explanation: Actual costs désigne les coûts réellement constatés, par opposition aux montants budgétés. Forecast, standard et budgeted ne désignent pas la réalisation constatée.

questions.q: Which word naturally completes this neutral status update: “We have not received your signed agreement ___.”
options: since
still
during
yet
questions.explanation: Yet se place naturellement en fin de cette phrase négative au present perfect. Since introduit un point de départ, during une période nominale ; still ne s’emploie pas ici à cette place.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly uses word order in an indirect question?
options: Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
Could you tell me when does the meeting start?
Could you tell me when starts the meeting?
Could you tell me when the meeting does starts?
questions.explanation: La question indirecte conserve ici l’ordre sujet-verbe : when the meeting starts. On n’y reprend pas l’inversion ni le does d’une question directe.

questions.q: Read: “Send the invoice and the delivery note to Accounts and Logistics, respectively.” According to this instruction, who should receive the invoice?
options: Logistics
Accounts
Both departments must receive both documents.
The sender may choose either department for each document.
questions.explanation: Respectively associe les éléments dans le même ordre : invoice avec Accounts, delivery note avec Logistics. Il ne signifie ni envoi de tout à tous ni choix libre des destinataires.
